# The Kettle on the Window Sill
- artist: The Fixture Trio
- key: G

## Verse 1
```
G             C
Morning on the sill
D              G
kettle singing low
Em            C
neighbours at the gate
D7             G
talking slow
```

## Chorus
```
C              G
Pour a cup for me
Am             D
the day is long
G              Em
leave the dishes
C       D7     G
we have time to spare
```
